objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact in the P&R system containing company-wide regulations and processes that can exist at multiple levels (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction) and goes through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document such as editing, review, released, archived, or out of force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document tracking revisions

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date when the document became or becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Date when the document validity expires

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation assigned to document category

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or title of the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related documents or master data

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Associated IT applications relevant to the document

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which document is archived before physical deletion

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document that is automatically released with the release of the main document and passes through all statuses of the release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle, can be deleted directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed modification to an existing document created by authors without affecting the document content or version history.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the P&R management system in various roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific roles and permissions for document management and distribution.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A workflow-supported request created by the system when a document reaches 30 days before validity expiration to verify if the document should be extended, revised, or invalidated.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A workflow-supported request created to invalidate and archive a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A workflow-supported request created to re-validate and restore an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of User Groups or persons who are automatically informed about the release of a corresponding document.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document format that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translation of released document content into another language that must be checked and released through workflow.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Active confirmation by recipients that they have received and read a distributed document.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participants during the approval process, documented in the system for traceability.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group that retains read access to archived documents while other groups have their authorizations revoked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initial creation of a new document object in the system with selection of document type and template.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content or properties including metadata, attributes, and file content.

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Upload of external files or documents to a document object.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read and change rights to users or user groups for specific documents through permission settings.

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of the workflow-supported approval process for a document by an author or co-author.

evts.name: creator_sign_document
evts.description: First step of the approval process where the registered author electronically signs the document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Step in the approval workflow where designated reviewers check document content for technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Refusal of approval during review or release step, causing workflow cancellation for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval step where designated releasers approve the document for publication, with at least one releaser required for approval.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after release, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of document from source format to PDF after content is saved.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of a new editing version when changes are made to released documents or their attachments.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachments for archiving to be archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a proposed modification to an existing document that clearly belongs to and is displayed in that document.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Action to schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled document attachment to a main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of a non-controlled document attachment to a main document.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Automatic transmission of document release notification by email to assigned users and user groups.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic request sent to recipients for active confirmation that they have received and read a distributed document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by a recipient that they have received and understood a distributed document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation that a document remains valid in its current version and updating of the valid until date.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of system-created request to verify if document should be extended, revised, or invalidated.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declaration of a document and its attachments as invalid and archiving them by withdrawing authorizations.

evts.name: request_override
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of a previously invalidated document and restoration of its status and authorizations.

evts.name: request_reactivation
evts.description: Workflow-supported request created by Business Admin group to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language by authorized translators.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported checking of a translated document version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Final approval of translated document version making it visible to authorized readers in corresponding language.

evts.name: assign_to_client
evts.description: Specification of which clients a document is visible or not visible in within a multi-client system.

o2o.description: A main document has attachments that are controlled documents released together with the main document
A document can have additional information that is not subject to the main document release cycle
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document
A released document has language versions that are translations into other languages
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute
A distribution list is maintained for a document specifying users and groups to be notified upon release
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type
A user group contains multiple users assigned specific roles and permissions
A distribution list contains assigned user groups
A distribution list contains assigned persons

Document content or properties are modified
External files are uploaded to a document
Users or user groups receive authorization assignments
Release workflow process is started for a document
The registered author electronically signs in the first approval step
Reviewers check the document content
A document is rejected during approval
Releasers approve the document for publication
Document is automatically published after release
Document is automatically converted to PDF after saving
A new version of a document is automatically created
Attachments are marked for archiving
A change proposal is created for a document
A change proposal is scheduled for implementation
A controlled attachment is added to a document
Additional information is added to a document
Users and user groups receive email notification of document release
Recipients are automatically requested to confirm acknowledgement
A recipient confirms receipt and reading of a document
Document validity is extended and valid until date is updated
System-created request for validity extension is processed
Document is declared invalid and archived
Request for document invalidation is processed
An invalidated document is re-validated and restored
Request for document reactivation is processed
Released document content is translated into another language
A translated document version is reviewed
A translated document version is approved and released
Document visibility is specified for clients in a multi-client system
